kwargs.profile_path: required: the profile directory being audited (the Hermes home for the default profile, <home>/profiles/<name> otherwise)
kwargs.host_platform: pass None (default -> sys.platform). The audited home's platform is not knowable in general; index.platform_excluded_count exposes how many skills the platform gate removed so the report can say the figure assumes the current platform
kwargs.disabled_skills: omit/None: read by the module itself from skills.disabled in <profile>/config.yaml (bounded safe read, no credential files). Explicit value overrides. skills.platform_disabled is session-dependent and not applied
kwargs.auto_load_skills: omit/None: read from skills.auto_load in <profile>/config.yaml. Explicit value overrides
kwargs.external_dirs: omit/None: read from skills.external_dirs in <profile>/config.yaml; only in-profile relative/absolute entries are walked, '~', '$', '..' and outside-profile entries are cuts. Explicit value overrides
kwargs.now: do not pass (accepted and ignored; ages are relative to the usage file's newest timestamp)
kwargs.clock: do not pass (test hook; default time.monotonic, used only for the MAX_SECONDS budget and run_metrics.elapsed_ms)

consequences.skill_packs.index_cost: The rendered skills index is above 17,000 characters or 150 listed skills and is sent with every request before any skill is opened; the character count is about the real size and an upper bound when listed skills depend on tools, apps or environments, and it does not include any skill body.
consequences.skill_packs.never_used: At least 70% of at least 20 non-stock skills with a usable observation window have zero recorded uses in skills/.usage.json; Hermes records a use only when a skill is loaded through skill_view, a slash command or a cron job, so this does not show reads by other means or use before recording began.
consequences.skill_packs.bulk_install: At least 20 non-stock skill folders share one install signal (identical license text, the same hub-lock source, or SKILL.md times within 2 minutes, which is a weak signal); this counts folders and does not show how or why they were installed.
consequences.skill_packs.stale_index_snapshot: The on-disk .skills_prompt_snapshot.json lists skill entries with no matching SKILL.md under skills/; Hermes rebuilds this cache when its manifest no longer matches, so this counts left-over cache entries and does not describe the current prompt.
consequences.skill_packs.always_on_skills: One or more non-stock skills are listed in skills.auto_load or carry an every-session cue in their frontmatter description; auto-loaded skills add their body to every session, while a description cue is wording only and does not show that the skill is loaded.
consequences.skill_packs.license_copies: More than 50 LICENSE, NOTICE or COPYING files inside skill folders share fewer distinct texts than files; this counts duplicated license files and does not show how the folders were installed.
consequences.skill_packs.could_not_verify: Skill pack usage or directory coverage could not be completely verified; missing usage records or bounded traversal cuts are not evidence of clean state or zero usage.

free_strings.what: usage.top_used_counts[].path (skill folder whose name matches a skills/.usage.json key; null when no such skill is on disk) and loaded_sizes.top_10_largest[].path (listed non-stock skill folders)
free_strings.why_safe: absolute realpath of an EXISTING skill folder at skill-folder depth (<profile>/skills/<category...>/<skill> or an in-profile external_dirs root); credential-named folders are never discovered. Serializer: EvidenceSerializer.scalar -> _path() resolves + lstat's it and returns it UNCHANGED (verified by test_sealing_keeps_every_measurement). Must still exist at serialisation time; a missing path would become a hashed token. Under a redaction scope a path overlapping a noted credential becomes a credential_overlap token.

free_strings.what: always_on.paths: up to 10 absolute folders of non-stock skills that are auto-loaded or carry an every-session description cue
free_strings.why_safe: same rule as path; kept unchanged

notes: adapt_component_result keeps unknown top-level keys: 'skill_packs' and 'run_metrics' are copied unchanged into the adapted result; 'status' becomes 'legacy_status_ignored'; 'coverage' is normalized and forced to could_not_verify if any finding is; 'ok', 'error', 'classification' come from the shared make_component_envelope helper and are ignored/recomputed. The caller must store run_metrics outside the fingerprinted report (store.finalize_run measurements only copies named sections).

Free strings: no skill NAME is emitted anywhere. Names with an existing folder are emitted as that folder's absolute realpath under path/paths (kept by the serializer); names without a file on disk are counted only: index.snapshot.stale_entries was removed (stale_count stays), usage.top_used_counts entries for skills not on disk carry path null. Two runs on an unchanged home give identical sealed sections and finding DTOs, and no sealed dict carries an hmac field (test_two_runs_give_identical_sealed_output_and_no_hashed_tokens).

Finding persistence (persistence.finding_dto) keeps evidence only for keys in _EVIDENCE_NUMERIC_KEYS (int/float/bool) and _EVIDENCE_VOCAB_KEYS (VOCABULARY strings); the module therefore emits no null, list or free-string evidence (bulk_install omits used_skills/used_share without verified usage; always_on_skills carries counts only).

Currently missing from the shared sets (the caller adds them from this file): rule ids and consequences for all 7 rules; numeric evidence keys skills chars runtime_gated_count platform_excluded_count zero_use_count never_used_share unverifiable_count weak_signal used_skills used_share snapshot_version snapshot_skills stale_entries description_cue_count distinct_texts bytes; vocab evidence keys signal truncated_by; vocabulary tokens skills/.usage.json .skills_prompt_snapshot.json unverified_inputs usage_file_* license_hash hub_lock_source mtime_window_2m and most truncated_by values; many schema keys. The sealing test computes the exact delta.
usage.recording_since / recording_until are integers YYYYMM (e.g. 202605), so they survive the serializer as numbers.

Wall-clock dependence: a run that exhausts MAX_SECONDS reports truncated_by='time_budget' and partial counts inside the section (coverage must say so); run_metrics.time_budget_hit flags this. On an unchanged home within budget the section is byte-identical across runs (test_output_is_deterministic_across_now_and_clock).

index_chars is the rendered block for the audited host platform with runtime-gated skills (requires_apps, environments with unknown tags, metadata.hermes tool/toolset/session-platform conditions) counted as listed: an upper bound when index.runtime_gated_count > 0; the index_cost sentence says 'about' and 'upper bound'.
Cuts from config.yaml (unparseable, duplicate keys, non-mapping skills block, ${VAR} in a value, non-string list items) make the section could_not_verify; config text never enters the output.

persistence.finding_dto adds evidence.source_digest = HMAC of the finding with the per-run serializer key; it differs between runs for every section (not specific to skill_packs). The two-run test removes it before comparing; the caller must keep it out of the digest or accept it.
